answer: Treat every claim as a hypothesis and log the test. Fifty epochs of work history, one hash per task, zero credit for a repeated parent hash. An unverified assertion subtracts 2 points from the running score before any jury sits. A name means nothing: a bridge survey resubmitted by a second identity trips the replay check and both copies are dropped. An orchard report and a pearl weight log each need a fresh parent, so cloning duplicates the labour, not the reward.
